steps.content: Traveled through the sandstorm, only to find an eerie spot of calm in the center of it all.

What appeared before the patrol ship was a luxury cruise liner that seemed to materialize out of thin air. Its outline was subtly distorted, nearly impossible to capture in its true form even through radar and visual systems. Only at extremely close range would traces of its existence become detectable.

Optical camouflage, a mobile cruise ship, Mania creatures lying in wait... and now an unnatural ash storm. These bastards have pulled out all the stops to hide their tracks. No wonder they've managed to stay off the grid.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: No wonder we couldn't find them. Using a Mania storm as cover... impressive tech.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no Apostle of Ashes activity nearby. An apocalyptic sandstorm like this shouldn't be possible.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Expand the search radius. There has to be something unusual nearby.

steps.speaker: DisCorps Soldier
steps.content: Over here!

Deep in a dune behind the cruise ship's stern, chains are tethered to a strange metal device. A strangely colored metal flows inside the black and gold apparatus, solidifying into a bizarre pattern in the center.

steps.speaker: DisCorps Soldier
steps.content: What is this thing...?
You've seen a design like this before... at the Great Expo.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is...

options: An Aurum Secretum device from the Outlands.
Aurum Secretum runes from the Underground.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Those bastards... they're close by...
You bypass the main entrance, pry open a hatch on the southwest, and slip quietly into the cruise's lower cargo hold.
You've only taken a few steps when the floor shudders beneath you.
BOOM!
The squad members are instantly alert, quickly adjusting into a defensive formation. The next second, a wrenching wave of Mania erupts through the cracks in the metal floor. Your heart sinks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's an ambush. Be careful.
The lights flicker as the floor splits open with a thunderous roar. More than a dozen puppets, covered in sorcery runes, lurch from the shadows, their joints twisting with metallic clicks.
They aren't security robots used for patrol. You know exactly what they are.
There's no mistaking them. These inhuman things are killing machines crafted using sorcery by the Underground!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Underground puppets!</color>
Not built for defense or deterrence, these are sorcery weapons designed for slaughter! It means they never intended to let anyone get out alive.
The doctor steps in front of you. Her briefcase snaps open, metal clasps sparking as her weapon returns to her hand. A brutal fight is inevitable.
